professionalSummary.text: Three‑year Program Manager at a platform company with proven experience leading API deprecation programmes using the company’s program method.
professionalSummary.witness: Program manager at a platform company for three years, running five API deprecation programmes under the platform's program method with their deprecation plans and developer communication schedules.

professionalSummary.text: Successfully answered external developers’ questions at 32 monthly developer calls, consistently meeting the communication standard’s five‑day response window.
professionalSummary.witness: Answered the external developers' questions at thirty-two monthly developer calls under the communication standard; the call transcripts and the follow‑up logs are in the developer relations archive, with every open question answered in writing within the standard's five days.

professionalSummary.text: Coordinated migration guides and tooling across API teams via a program tracker, ensuring readiness at each deprecation milestone.
professionalSummary.witness: Coordinated the API teams' migration guides and tooling through the program tracker, with the guide and tool readiness recorded against each deprecation milestone.

professionalSummary.text: Prepared shutdown readiness reviews, documenting responsibilities and aligning shutdown dates set by platform leadership.
professionalSummary.witness: Prepared the shutdown readiness review for each deprecation; the shutdown dates were set by the platform leadership, recorded on the review together with which checks were mine and which the API teams'.

professionalSummary.text: Authored closure reports with program boundary statements and traffic evidence confirming deprecation completion, approved by the head of platform programs.
professionalSummary.witness: Wrote the closure report for each programme with the program boundary statement and the traffic evidence that the old version was unused, accepted by the head of platform programs.

experienceHighlights.text: Led five API deprecation programmes, each following a structured plan and communication schedule.
experienceHighlights.witness: running five API deprecation programmes under the platform's program method with their deprecation plans and developer communication schedules.

experienceHighlights.text: Managed 32 monthly developer calls, addressing hostile questions and providing clear guidance on migration paths.
experienceHighlights.witness: given a hostile question from a panel member playing an external developer, the candidate restated the question in the developer's terms, gave the shutdown date and the migration guide section that covered the developer's case, said which two items were not yet decided and when they would be, and offered to follow up in writing within five days.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Deprecation plan and communication schedule, developer call transcripts with follow‑up logs, shutdown readiness review, and closure report available as verifiable work samples.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: one deprecation plan with its communication schedule, two developer call transcripts with follow‑up logs, one shutdown readiness review with the leadership's date decision and one closure report, with the archive references as a verification trail.

skills.text: Program management, stakeholder communication, migration guide coordination, traffic analysis, documentation, and cross‑functional collaboration.
